# Takkar (playtakkar.in)

> Takkar is a free daily quiz duel for people in India preparing for government exams: SSC CGL, IBPS PO and RRB NTPC. Each duel is ten quant and reasoning questions in the chosen exam's pattern, marking and timing, against a rival or a friend, with step-by-step solutions. Tutors and coaching centres can get verified and run a private league for each batch. Takkar is for adults (18 and over) and has no cash prizes, betting or paid contests.

Takkar is in beta. It runs in any browser and as an Android app. It is independent and not affiliated with any exam-conducting organisation; for official exam dates and notices, see ssc.gov.in, ibps.in and the regional RRB websites.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.playtakkar.in/): what Takkar is, how a duel works, squads, Plus, questions and answers
- [Play in the browser](https://www.playtakkar.in/play/): the web app, free, no download
- [Android app](https://www.playtakkar.in/beta): download, install steps and the file's SHA-256 fingerprint
- [Practice questions with solutions](https://www.playtakkar.in/practice): percentages, profit and loss, time and work, syllogism, number series, coding and decoding
- [For tutors and coaching centres](https://www.playtakkar.in/tutors): leagues for each batch, getting verified, the free beta plan

## Exam patterns Takkar follows

Full guides: [SSC CGL Tier 1](https://www.playtakkar.in/ssc-cgl), [IBPS PO Prelims](https://www.playtakkar.in/ibps-po), [RRB NTPC CBT 1](https://www.playtakkar.in/rrb-ntpc)

- SSC CGL Tier 1: +2 for a right answer, −0.5 for a wrong one, about 36 seconds a question
- IBPS PO prelims: a quarter of the question’s marks off for a wrong answer, 20 minutes for each of the three sections
- RRB NTPC CBT 1: +1 right, −⅓ wrong, about 54 seconds a question
